## Scope and biological question

Using the **UT reference transcriptome**, we ask whether LPS-associated isoform switching in **UBL5 knockout (U)** differs from **wildtype THP1 (T)**.

This report:

1. Ranks significant switching genes in `T_UT` and `U_UT` (same q / |dIF| rules as elsewhere).
2. Classifies genes as **Shared**, **T-only**, or **U-only**.
3. Matches isoforms by `isoform_id` for delta-dIF / concordance statistics.
4. Provides visual overlap summaries and **gene-level explorer** panels (side-by-side T vs U dIF).
5. Includes IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR switch plots for showcase genes.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

source("_setup.R")
fig <- make_fig("ut_t_vs_u")
gene_fig <- make_fig(file.path("ut_t_vs_u", "gene_explorer"))
switch_fig <- make_fig(file.path("ut_t_vs_u", "switch_plots"))
```

## What can and cannot be concluded here

Read this before the numbers.

- **Effect sizes are the interpretable quantities.** With thousands of matched isoforms,
  the Wilcoxon p-values below are driven by sample size; the median ΔdIF is what says
  whether knockout shifts isoform usage, and by how much.
- **T-only / U-only counts are bounded by object retention**, not by biology. Only the
  symbols retained in *both* saved objects can ever be called shared, so the great
  majority of "T-only" genes are simply absent from the U object.
- **No enrichment test is reported.** A Fisher test of "significant in T" × "significant
  in U" previously appeared here. Its background was 25 already-significant genes, so it
  measured association inside a set already selected on the outcome. It has been removed
  rather than reported with a caveat.
- **Statistics prefixed `selconf_` are conditioned on significance in both datasets.**
  Selecting on the outcome in both and then measuring agreement manufactures agreement;
  treat them as descriptions of the shared set, not as evidence of concordance.

### Retention accounting

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  retention |> select(-note),
  caption = "How many gene symbols survive in each saved object, and how they split"
)
knitr::kable(rtab, caption = "Symbols retained in both objects: switching in T × switching in U (counts only, no test)")
```

### One-way concordance (the defensible comparison)

Condition on significance in **one** dataset, then measure the effect in the other. Unlike
the shared-significant statistics, this does not select on the outcome twice.

```{r}
knitr::kable(oneway, digits = 2, caption = "Effect in the other dataset, conditioning on significance in one")
```

## Shared vs unique genes

### Shared genes (first 40)

```{r}
shared <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "Shared (T and U)") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$max_abs_dif_either)) |>
  head(40) |>
  select(
    gene_name, T_max_abs_dif, U_max_abs_dif, delta_max_abs_dif,
    T_n_switching, U_n_switching, T_min_q, U_min_q,
    T_novel_involved, U_novel_involved
  )
knitr::kable(shared, digits = 4, caption = "Shared significant genes (top by max |dIF|)")
```

### T-only (first 30)

```{r}
t_only <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "T-only") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$T_max_abs_dif)) |>
  head(30) |>
  select(gene_name, T_max_abs_dif, T_n_switching, T_min_q, T_novel_involved, T_opposing)
knitr::kable(t_only, digits = 4, caption = "T-only significant genes")
```

### U-only (first 30)

```{r}
u_only <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "U-only") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$U_max_abs_dif)) |>
  head(30) |>
  select(gene_name, U_max_abs_dif, U_n_switching, U_min_q, U_novel_involved, U_opposing)
knitr::kable(u_only, digits = 4, caption = "U-only significant genes")
```

## Gene-level explorer

Each panel shows isoform dIF for the same gene in **T_UT** and **U_UT** (novel isoforms tagged `(PB)`).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Gene explorer panels (subset by overlap class)"
#| out-width: "100%"
ok <- gidx[!is.na(gidx$figure) & nzchar(gidx$figure), , drop = FALSE]
show <- ok |>
  group_by(.data$overlap_class) |>
  slice_head(n = 6) |>
  ungroup()
paths <- existing_figs(vapply(show$figure, gene_fig, character(1)))
if (length(paths)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_No gene explorer figures found._\n")
}
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  show[, c("gene_name", "overlap_class", "figure", "T_max_abs_dif", "U_max_abs_dif")],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Gene explorer figures included above"
)
```

## Switch plots (showcase)

ISA `switchPlot` panels (gene symbols + PB labels when available).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Showcase switchPlots for shared / T-only / U-only genes"
#| out-width: "100%"
ok <- sidx
ok$ok_flag <- ok$ok %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true", 1, "1")
ok <- ok[!is.na(ok$figure) & nzchar(ok$figure) & ok$ok_flag, , drop = FALSE]
show_sw <- ok |>
  group_by(.data$overlap_class, .data$dataset) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  ungroup()
paths_sw <- existing_figs(vapply(show_sw$figure, switch_fig, character(1)))
if (length(paths_sw)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths_sw)
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_No switch plots found._\n")
}
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  show_sw[, c("gene_name", "overlap_class", "dataset", "figure")],
  caption = "Switch plots included above"
)
```

## Methods notes

- Significance uses `config/config.yml` thresholds (`isoform_q`, `gene_q`, `min_abs_dif`).
- **Gene overlap** uses cleaned gene symbols (not `XLOC_*` / `ENSG*`), because those IDs are not stably shared across condition objects.
- **Isoform matching** uses `isoform_id` (`TCONS`) within the UT reference. Isoforms absent from one genotype's object are labelled *not retained in*, not *missing* — they were dropped when that object was reduced to switching genes, so their status there is unknown rather than negative.
- **|dIF| by class** measures each isoform in exactly one dataset. It previously summarised the Shared class with `pmax(T, U)` against single values for T-only/U-only, which biased Shared upward by construction.
- Rebuild:

```bash
Rscript scripts/04_comparison_T_vs_U.R
quarto render reports/ut_t_vs_u_comparison.qmd
```
